change: Extended the cited-text numeric guard to require exact numeric-plus-unit/denominator matches for a conservative supported set of measurement units.

new_cases: Reject 7 kg CO2e/L when cited text reports 7 t CO2e/year.
Accept 7 t CO2e/year with Unicode CO₂ and spacing variation when cited text reports the same value and unit.

limits: The unit matcher covers only the explicit unit forms encoded in the allowlist; unrecognized units are not semantically compared.
A matching value/unit still does not prove that the statistic answers the question or shares the same period/boundary.
No live Gemini call, database query, Production deployment, or route enablement.
